findings: Non-blocking (likely): global 401 interceptor in api.js removes carpool_token but leaves AuthContext user set, so the UI looks logged in until reload; route through context logout or drop the interceptor.
Non-blocking (likely): isNetworkError treats any error without a response (including client-side TypeErrors) as offline; also check err.isAxiosError/err.request.
Non-blocking (possible, coder-reported): top safe-area inset sits on a non-sticky wrapper, so the sticky Navbar may slide under a notch; verify on a device.
